title: Application Engineer I
description:
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**
 As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

 We are a
 **Great Place To Work\-Certified** 
 organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy


**What You Will Do**
 The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre\-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
* Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
* Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
* Preparation and participation for project kick\-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
* Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
* Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
* Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write\-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
* Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
* Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope\-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
* Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
* Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives


**What We Look For**
* BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics \& Communication).
* Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
* Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
* Must be a quick learner, team player \& should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.


**Preferred**
 3 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.
   

  

 Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou.

title: Technical Account Consultant - Platform
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

* 3\+ years of SaaS experience in customer success, consulting, implementation, or support
* Preferred: 2\+ years experience with building reports, working within data, enabling customers with reporting needs.
* Passion for helping customers and colleagues
* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Master project / task manager – you never drop the ball
* Ability to explain complex scenarios in simple, clear written or verbal communications
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Interest in actively working with product and engineering teams

 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
   

  

 This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
**Company Description**




  





 Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
 



 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
 



 Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
 



 Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
 



 To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast
 **On the Move** 
 to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the
 **latest news** 
 in the industry. You can also follow us on
 **LinkedIn** 
 and
 **Instagram.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Operational Excellence Manager will drive the Operational Excellence agenda across VVN global mobility operations in India. A key priority will be to identify, adapt, and scale proven improvement practices from across Vialto, ensuring successful approaches are consistently embedded within local operations. The role will build organizational capability through continuous improvement training, methodologies, and tools, while partnering with operational leaders to standardize processes, establish governance, and implement performance measurement frameworks that enable sustainable improvements and measurable business outcomes.
 



 The role will support broader process improvement and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance service delivery. Working closely with operational and functional stakeholders, the successful candidate will assess opportunities, develop business cases, define requirements, and coordinate the delivery of improvement initiatives. While experience with automation is advantageous, this is primarily a business\-facing role focused on opportunity assessment, solution design, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realization rather than hands\-on automation development.
 



 Reporting to the Operational Excellence Lead, this role is part of a broader enabling functions team that combines expertise in process improvement, automation, analytics, and other support capabilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead process improvement initiatives using structured Operational Excellence methodologies and project management disciplines.
* Design and deliver training on Operational Excellence methodologies, tools, and best practices, and coach teams in their practical application.
* Map end\-to\-end processes, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and drive process simplification and standardization.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify and assess improvement and automation opportunities, develop business cases, define business requirements, and support benefit tracking and realization.
* Identify, adapt, and promote proven improvement practices from across Vialto to drive consistency and accelerate outcomes.
* Oversee governance of the improvement portfolio, including initiative prioritization, benefit validation, progress tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to support consistent service delivery and continuous improvement across regions.



**Required Qualifications** 



* At least five years of experience in Operational Excellence, process improvement, continuous improvement, or a related field.
* Practical experience in process mapping, performance measurement, and operational standards development.

title: Content Writer — Finance and SEO
description:
**About Stockify** 




 Stockify is one of India's fastest\-growing marketplaces for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, helping retail and HNI investors discover and invest in high\-potential companies before they list on public exchanges. Our platform covers a wide universe of unlisted stocks across sectors, and we publish research, market updates and investor education content that helps people make better investment decisions. Content is central to how we build trust, drive organic traffic and grow our investor community. We are now looking for a skilled Content Writer who can produce finance content that is both deeply informative and built to rank.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a writing\-first role. You will be responsible for producing high\-quality, SEO\-optimised blog articles, landing page copy, company profiles and investor education content for stockify.net.in. The content you write will serve two audiences simultaneously: search engines that need clear signals of relevance and authority, and investors who need accurate, readable and genuinely useful information about unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investing and the companies available on the Stockify platform.
 



 We are not looking for someone who can produce high volumes of generic finance articles. We are looking for a writer who researches before writing, understands how search intent works, can explain complex financial concepts in plain language without dumbing them down, and takes pride in producing content that is both credible and engaging.
 



 If you have a finance background or have spent meaningful time writing about capital markets, investments or fintech, and you understand what it takes to make a piece of content rank on Google, this role is for you.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Blog and Long\-Form Content** 



* Research, plan and write SEO\-optimised blog articles on topics including unlisted share investing, pre\-IPO opportunities, company analysis, market trends, ESOP liquidation, SME IPOs and investor education
* Produce well\-structured long\-form content in the range of 1,000 to 2,500 words per article, with clear headings, logical flow, strong internal linking and accurate financial information throughout
* Work from SEO briefs provided by the SEO Manager, including target keywords, intent mapping, suggested structure and competitor benchmarks, and consistently deliver content that meets or exceeds those briefs
* Conduct independent research using company filings, DRHP documents, market data, SEBI announcements and credible financial news sources to ensure every article is factually accurate and up to date
* Optimise every article for on\-page SEO including keyword placement, meta title and description writing, heading hierarchy, image alt text and internal link suggestions



  





**Company and Product Pages** 



* Write and update company profile pages for unlisted stocks listed on the Stockify platform, covering business overview, financials, recent developments, shareholding structure and investment considerations
* Draft and refresh landing page copy for key product and category pages including unlisted share price lists, sector\-specific pages and investor resources
* Ensure all product and company page content is accurate, current and written in a way that serves both search discoverability and investor decision\-making



  





**Social and Supporting Content** 



* Repurpose long\-form blog content into LinkedIn posts, WhatsApp updates and short\-form summaries for use across Stockify's distribution channels
* Support the marketing team with content for email newsletters, investor communication and campaign\-specific copy as required
* Contribute to the monthly content calendar planning by suggesting relevant topics based on market events, search trends and investor questions



  





**Quality and Compliance** 



* Ensure all published content adheres to SEBI guidelines on investment communication, includes appropriate disclaimers and avoids making unsubstantiated return claims or investment recommendations
* Maintain a consistent brand voice across all content, writing like a knowledgeable and trustworthy source rather than a promotional one
* Self\-edit rigorously before submission, checking for factual accuracy, grammatical correctness, SEO compliance and brand tone in every draft



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Two to four years of content writing experience with a demonstrable focus on finance, investment, fintech, capital markets or a related domain
* A strong portfolio of published SEO\-optimised articles in the finance or investment space that you can share as part of your application
* Working knowledge of SEO content principles including keyword research, search intent, on\-page optimisation, internal linking and meta writing
* The ability to read and interpret financial documents such as DRHPs, annual reports, balance sheets and press releases, and translate them into clear and readable content for a general investor audience
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs or Ubersuggest for keyword research and content gap analysis
* A high standard of written English with strong self\-editing skills and zero tolerance for factual errors in published content
* Awareness of SEBI content guidelines and the regulatory sensitivities of writing about investment products in India
* Bonus: Prior experience writing specifically about unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, PMS, AIF or alternative investment products



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Writers who produce high volumes of generic, templated content without original research or genuine financial understanding
* Candidates who rely on AI\-generated drafts without substantial human editing, fact\-checking and rewriting
* Anyone who has not written specifically about finance, investment or fintech at a professional level



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Fixed: Rs. 30,000 per month
* Performance Incentives: Upto 3 months Bonus based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision

description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Posting Description
   

  

**The Future Begins Here**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
   

  

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**
 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE**
* Support the realization of Medical Governance Office (MGO) strategy by ensuring that the data, records, decisions, and governance knowledge used by MGO are complete, current, easy to find, traceable, and managed consistently.
* Establish and lead the Medical Data Governance \& Knowledge Management capability within the Bengaluru Global Capability Center, developing the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework and supporting the realization of MGO and broader Global Medical priorities.
* Translate approved MGO and Global Medical priorities into clear business definitions, data standards, relationships, and knowledge structures that connect Medical information and support trusted search, retrieval, reuse, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Work directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO capability leads to deliver agreed priorities and expected outcomes, and stay closely connected to Medical teams so the capability reflects daily operations and business needs. MGO and relevant Medical domain owners retain responsibility for strategy, scientific and business meaning, and final decisions.


**Accountabilities**
**Medical Data Stewardship and Business Glossary**
* Act as the operational steward for assigned Medical data domains. Work with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners to document and maintain approved business definitions, critical data elements, data lineage, ownership, metadata, and data\-quality expectations.
* Own and maintain the Medical business glossary and domain\-level metadata standards for the assigned scope, coordinating proposed changes with MGO and the relevant Medical domain owners.
* Maintain an inventory of the data, reports, repositories, systems, owners, and key definitions within the assigned scope. Run regular checks to identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, outdated, or incorrectly classified information and coordinate correction with the responsible owners.
* Ensure that data used for MGO oversight, dashboards, reporting, and decision support is consistently defined, linked to the agreed official source, and supported by clear data\-quality checks, lineage, and traceable records.


**Medical Ontology, Knowledge Management and Repository Governance**
* Develop the Medical ontology (the agreed structure of terms, definitions, classifications, and relationships used to connect Medical information consistently) and knowledge management framework.
* Own and maintain the Medical ontology, taxonomies, metadata standards, and controlled vocabularies for the assigned scope, coordinating significant changes with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners.
* Work with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners to define and maintain the relationships across Medical data, content, evidence, insights, processes, decisions, and knowledge assets so information can be connected, found, and reused.
* Work with MGO to define practical ways of recording and maintaining governance decisions, approvals, exceptions, standards, frameworks, guidance, templates, and supporting rationale, based on approved MGO and Takeda requirements.
* Ensure that governance records and knowledge are correctly captured, named, classified, linked to related records, version\-controlled, accessible to the right users, periodically reviewed, retained, archived, and retired.
* Oversee regular repository checks to make sure that information is complete, current, correctly linked, and easy to retrieve. Maintain the evidence needed for audit and inspection readiness and work to address identified gaps.
* Help MGO and assigned Medical teams capture, maintain, find, share, and reuse current governance knowledge, reducing duplication and the use of outdated or conflicting materials.


**MGO Functional Partnership and Enablement**
* Receive functional direction from the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO capability leads on priorities, approved requirements, and expected outcomes. Translate these into clear workplans, deliverables, and timelines.
* Provide regular updates to MGO on progress, data quality, repository status, missing information, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities. Escalate significant gaps, risks, or unresolved ownership questions.
* Maintain regular engagement with MGO leads and Medical teams to understand daily operations, terminology, decisions, user needs, and emerging priorities, ensuring that the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework remain relevant and practical.
* Lead the operational transition of agreed data\-governance, governance\-record, repository, and knowledge\-management activities into Bengaluru. Ensure that scope, responsibilities, handoffs, standards, controls, training needs, and escalation routes are clearly documented before transition.
* Turn agreed business needs into clear requirements for repositories, workflows, access, search, integration, and reporting. Partner closely with Medical DD\&T and the Enterprise AI team to define the business requirements for the Medical knowledge architecture, semantic layer, Medical knowledge graph, AI\-supported search and retrieval, and future approved AI\-enabled workflows. Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI remain responsible for technical architecture and implementation.


**DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS**
**Technical/Functional Expertise**
* Strong knowledge of data governance and knowledge management in a regulated environment, including data stewardship, business glossaries, critical data elements, data lineage, ontology, taxonomy, metadata, data quality, records management, and knowledge reuse.
* Good understanding of Medical Affairs governance and operations, with the ability to turn approved governance requirements into clear and practical data and knowledge\-management practices.
* Understands the difference between managing data, records, and repositories and owning the underlying content or decision. Scientific, policy, compliance, legal, privacy, information\-security, technology, clinical\-data, and business decisions remain with the relevant accountable owners unless formally delegated.


**Leadership**
* Provides functional leadership to data owners, data stewards, repository owners, knowledge contributors, system owners, and project teams involved in the assigned scope.
* Translates agreed priorities into clear responsibilities, workplans, and delivery expectations and helps teams apply approved standards consistently.
* Influences stakeholders without relying only on formal authority and brings together the appropriate owners to resolve data, repository, and knowledge\-management issues.


**Decision\-Making and Autonomy**
* Acts as the business owner for the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework and is accountable for its business requirements, operating model, roadmap, adoption, and ongoing evolution within approved MGO and Global Medical direction.
* Within approved requirements, makes operational decisions about the business glossary, ontology, taxonomy, metadata, controlled vocabularies, data\-quality controls, knowledge relationships, repository practices, and issue remediation.
* Escalates questions that involve governance strategy, substantive content, scientific interpretation, policy, compliance, Legal, Privacy, Information Security, enterprise architecture, clinical or RWE data governance, or business ownership.
* MGO and relevant Medical domain owners retain accountability for governance strategy, scientific and business meaning, and approval of significant domain\-specific definitions and relationships. Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI retain accountability for technical architecture and implementation.


**Interaction**
* Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO leads on priorities, expected outcomes, workplans, progress, and escalation, and maintains regular contact with Medical teams to ensure the capability reflects day\-to\-day business context.
* Maintains close alignment with the GCM Medical Operations \& Governance Lead as the formal line manager and with Medical Excellence \& Operations on the broader Bengaluru operating model and cross\-capability dependencies.
* Collaborates closely with Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI, as well as Records Information Management, Quality, Privacy, Ethics \& Compliance, Legal, Information Security, system owners, and global, regional, and local Medical stakeholders.


**Innovation**
* Identifies practical opportunities to use ontology, semantic search, knowledge graphs, automation, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools to improve how Medical information is connected, found, understood, and reused.
* Ensures that digital and AI\-enabled solutions are introduced with appropriate validation, access controls, human oversight, traceability, and alignment with applicable Takeda requirements.


**Complexity**
* Works across different Medical governance areas, data sources, repositories, systems, functions, and geographies.
* Balances the need for common global ways of working with valid legal, regulatory, privacy, records\-management, and local requirements.
* Helps move fragmented or locally maintained data and knowledge practices toward more consistent, traceable, and reusable approaches without taking ownership of the underlying scientific, policy, or business decisions.


**Education, Behavioural Competencies And Skills**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, data or information management, library and information science, information systems, quality, business, or a related discipline is required.
* An advanced degree or relevant professional certification in data governance, knowledge management, records and information management, or a related field is preferred.


**Experience**
* Eight or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least four years in the biopharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated experience in data governance, knowledge management, records and information management, repository management, data quality, or Medical operations.
* Experience establishing or improving data\-ownership practices, common definitions, data\-quality checks, repository structures, document\-lifecycle practices, or knowledge\-management processes.
* Experience with business glossaries, ontologies, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, semantic relationships, knowledge graphs, semantic search, or similar knowledge\-management capabilities.
* Experience working with Medical Affairs, quality, governance, compliance, or another regulated business area in a global or matrixed organization.
* Experience providing project, team, or matrix leadership and influencing stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Experience supporting the transition or centralization of activities into a global capability center or shared\-services organization is preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of data stewardship, business glossaries, critical data elements, data lineage, ontology, taxonomy, metadata standards, controlled vocabularies, data quality, traceability, access, retention, and issue\-management processes.
* Experience managing document, record, or knowledge repositories, including naming conventions, classification, access controls, versioning, links between records, review cycles, retention, archiving, and retrieval.
* Experience with platforms such as Veeva Vault, SharePoint, enterprise data catalogues, document\-management systems, records\-management systems, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Records Information Management, controlled documentation, privacy, information security, and audit and inspection\-readiness requirements in a regulated environment.
* Experience with dashboards, workflow tools, data\-quality monitoring, search technologies, automation, or AI\-enabled tools applied to data or knowledge\-management activities.
* Ability to translate Medical business needs into clear requirements for data, knowledge, search, and AI solutions.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Structured and practical thinker with strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex governance requirements into clear operational standards and ways of working.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and can distinguish issues that can be resolved operationally from those that require escalation to MGO or another accountable function.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, facilitation, and communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority and explain data\-governance and knowledge\-management topics clearly.
* Collaborative and pragmatic working style, with strong ownership, follow\-through, and commitment to quality, transparency, inclusion, and continuous improvement.


**Languages**
 Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous.
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Formal line reporting is to the GCM Medical Operations \& Governance Lead.
* For MGO\-assigned scope, the role works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office, who provides functional direction on priorities, approved requirements, expected outcomes, workplans, and escalation of significant issues.

**Benefits**
 It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are:

title: Tech Lead — Corporate (CSR) Business Unit
description:
Position: Tech Lead — Corporate (CSR) Business Unit
   

  

 Location: Bangalore (Preferred)/Mumbai/Gurgaon/Delhi
   

  

 Job Type: 1 year contract
   

  

**About Sattva**
 We Partner to deliver social impact at scale
   

  

 Sattva Consulting is an Indian\-origin, Global impact consulting firm and since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, businesses and government to deliver societal impact at scale.
   

  

 We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our research \& advisory services, knowledge platforms and collaborative initiatives.
   

  

 Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Corporate Advisory Business Unit works as a strategic advisor to companies solving social problems at scale. The work spans CSR strategy and flagship programme design; impact portfolio advisory, covering compliance, portfolio governance, social audit, programme monitoring and impact measurement; and end\-to\-end programme management through implementation support, advisory and in\-house tools.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We are hiring a Tech Lead to anchor technology across our Corporate (CSR) Business Unit: the platform our CSR programmes run on, the partner who builds it, and the AI and data work that is changing how the unit delivers. You will report to the Corporate BU Head and have a dotted line to the Chief Technology Officer.
   

  

 We are looking for 5–8 years in product management or technology services/consulting.
   

  

 The Corporate BU is growing in both the volume and the complexity of its engagements, and technology has moved from supporting that work to shaping what the work can be. We manage our CSR programmes on a purpose\-built platform, mGrant, from Dhwani RIS.
   

  

 AI presents a fast\-emerging opportunity in this space. Inside the unit, consultants are already piloting with it in processes like NGO due diligence and impact assessment. Outside, there are services we can build and sell — like putting Voice AI into our Impact Portfolio Advisory. What the unit needs now is someone to hold all of this together: to set the standard for the platform and the partnership, and to turn promising pilots into offerings we can take to market.
   

  

 The Ideal Candidate
   

  

* 5–8 years of experience in product management or technology services/consulting.
* A solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle in an Agile setting.
* Expertise in using AI to solve real problems — analysing data, building prototypes, knowing where it does and does not help.
* Proven experience getting B2B technology adopted inside teams, using change management and supporting behavioural change.
* Fluency in managing stakeholder relationships, internally and externally.
* Comfort with ambiguity and several parallel priorities, and the judgement to call what to focus on, what to defer, and which risks need active management.
* Clear communication in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment, and openness to occasional travel for project and client work.


 What would give you an edge:
   

  

* Experience in the social sector.
* Past work on CSR projects, particularly an understanding of how a CSR monitoring and evaluation project runs end to end.
* Experience with CSR technology tools and platforms.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

* Drive and Manage tech platform adoption within the CSR Business Unit, playing a central role across all CSR projects in the unit
* Interface with the project leads and consultants in the unit and enable successful delivery of CSR projects using the tech platform
* Drive end\-to\-end governance of our engagement with Dhwani RIS, our technology partner behind mGrant and other potential partners
* Interface with NGO users of the tech platform, and support them on tech platform related requirements.


 What you will support:
   

  

* Client\-facing: integrating Voice AI into our Impact Portfolio Advisory (IPA) and assessment offerings, and prototyping new services we can take to IPA clients.
* Internal: optimising the workflow for processes like due diligence, impact assessment and other processes in the CSR lifecyle.
* Knowledge management: building the unit’s discipline and driving the adoption of our AI\-based knowledge management solution.
* Data: enabling longitudinal CSR insight drawn from integrating mGrant with our internal data warehouse.
* Working with the unit's AI Champions — the consultants already experimenting on their own projects — to turn what works into something productised.


 Why Sattva?
   

  

 It's not about us really\- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
   

  

* Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design
* Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment
* Learn \& Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can
* Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow


 How to Prepare?
   

  

 This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality
   

  

 and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.
   

  

 FAQs on the Hiring Process
   

  

 Next Steps
   

  

 Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all!
   

  

 Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing all employees with education, training, and development opportunities to create a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and included.
   

  

 Please note: The organization follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy, under which employees are required to use their personal laptops for work purposes, subject to compliance with the company’s information security and IT policies. Necessary tools for operating, like MS office etc, will be provided

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise\-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client\-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands\-on technical execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI\-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI\-generated or AI\-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C\+\+, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post\-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best\-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer\-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C\+\+, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third\-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise\-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Analyst Quality Programs
description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
   

  

 Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Overview About TII**
 At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
   

  

 The Service Centers and Strategy \& Enablement (SC, S\&E) organization) is close to the action when it comes to communication— whether with guests or Target team members. From guest service professionals and product designers to vendor managers and financial and workforce management analysts, SC,S\&E comprises several key and high visibility areas that elevate and nurture Target’s distinctive reputation. We cultivate loyalty and satisfaction through exceptional service and support. And we foster a culture of responsive, knowledgeable and committed service—from the inside out—through enterprise services our people can count on.
   

  

 SC includes several contact centers focused on the quick and seamless resolution of a variety of issues. From CircleCard, Guest Services to the Client Support Center (CSC), we pride ourselves on infusing every interaction with that signature Target service that guests and team members alike have come to expect. We directly support Target’s bottom line through building guest loyalty as the retailer of choice and taking care of our team members so that they can get back to work they do best, from headquarters to stores to distribution centers.
   

  

 As an Analyst Quality audit, you will need to collaborate with various Service center partners and identify projects/processes aligning key objectives that enhance Guest Experience, Agent performance, Process improvements and Technology changes. You need to display a high level of curiosity to dig into data to understand themes \& patterns, identify root causes, check\-in on progress, take action to address roadblocks/challenges to deliver on project outcomes. You will need to build strong relationships with business and collaborate with other analysts to ensure alignment and understanding of business objectives and KPIs. In addition to supporting the process improvement projects, support quality program on various parameters defined by quality applications within Target, for Service center team members in accordance with specific SOP’s whenever required. Ensure consistency and accuracy in quality assessments across the team through regular calibration sessions/listening forums. Develop a deeper Subject matter expertise in the area you support. You will need to continuously upskill on various tools and technologies that may be required for implementation of process improvement outcomes.
   

  

 Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Conduct quality evaluations, audits, calibration sessions, listening forums, and quality reviews to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Execute Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities to ensure adherence to quality standards, SOPs, and compliance requirements.
* Perform root cause analysis using structured methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone, and Pareto Analysis.
* Develop corrective and preventive action plans and track effectiveness of implemented solutions.
* Lead and support cross\-functional quality and process improvement projects from planning through implementation and benefit realization.
* Develop project plans, track milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and provide stakeholder communications.
* Develop reports, dashboards, scorecards, and business insights using data visualization and analytics tools.
* Leverage Lean Six Sigma, automation, and GenAI\-enabled quality solutions to improve business outcomes.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and Analytics teams to implement and optimize quality\-related capabilities and tools.
* Monitor key quality metrics and business KPIs and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Develop subject matter expertise in assigned business areas and remain current on quality, analytics, AI, and operational excellence trends.


**About You**
* Three\-year degree or equivalent experience with 4–6 years of relevant experience, or MBA with 3–5 years of relevant experience.
* 4–6 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Quality Programs, Operational Excellence, Project Management, Process Improvement, Analytics, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting cross\-functional projects, including planning, stakeholder management, execution, and results tracking.
* Strong experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and applying structured problem\-solving methodologies to operational and quality challenges.
* Experience developing action plans and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of quality monitoring platforms such as NICE, Genesys, Verint, or equivalent systems.
* Experience leveraging automation, AI\-enabled solutions, or Generative AI capabilities in business processes preferred.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, and project management methodologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong collaboration, partnership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently with a high level of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Continuous learner with curiosity for quality transformation, analytics, emerging technologies, and operational excellence.

title: Engineer - Projects & Field Support
description:
**Why 75F**
 It is estimated that 80% of the commercial buildings in India in the year 2030 haven’t been built yet. Those that remain will require significant upgrades to core systems and capabilities.
   

  

 According to the India Cooling Action Plan (ICAP) by 2030 the energy required to cool our commercial buildings and cities will more than triple to 20% of energy use and carbon emissions nationwide. As plans for new construction rapidly accelerate and cooling energy needs rise, the India Economic Survey warns that equipping our commercial buildings with clean, healthy technology is essential to quality of life and our planet.
   

  

 75F does not design or build the cities that shape the future of India, but we do make them more connected, energy efficient, and healthy than any other solution on the market today. Best of all, our solution uses a unique and award\-winning wireless architecture so traditional barriers of cost and complexity disappear. This means that with 75F, every business and office in India — new build or retrofit — can quickly be upgraded into a smarter, more sustainable one.
   

  

**There Is a Two Part Secret To Our Success**
 The first is our proprietary, cloud\-enabled hardware and software, which optimizes and automates any existing HVAC and lighting systems. Together, these account for industry\-leading energy savings of 30 to 50%.
   

  

 The second is our team. At 75F, our employees don’t just believe in a new future for India and cities around the world, they are working to shape it. A future that isn’t dependent on finding foreign sources of energy, but one that makes better use of the energy produced today. One where our innovation and potential isn’t limited by what the cost per kilowatt is a decade from now or a century from now, but in our conviction about the trillions of Lakh and millions of tons of carbon that can collectively be saved.
   

  

**About 75F**
 75F is a rapidly growing technology company based in the US and Bangalore with offices and customers across India. Our investors are led by Bill Gates and include some of the biggest names in climate and technology, and 75F as a company has been named one of the top 100 greenest businesses in the world two years in a row.
   

  

 We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for passionate individuals who are committed to developing themselves and working together to solve some of the world’s toughest challenges. We value teamwork, innovation, extreme ownership, and tenacity above all other things. Finally, we believe we can’t build a new future for India without first building a diverse and inclusive team so we hire the best candidates we can based on an evaluation of their potential, not just their past experience in HVAC or IoT.
   

  

 If you motivated by the feeling of accomplishment, of being a part of a winning team, or desire to contribute to a technology that makes a measurable difference to your city, your country, and to all future generations, we want you to join us.

* Set up the pre and post\-sales customer support infrastructure. Will include call logging, escalation, deployment of in\-house \& outsourced engineers in the field, call closure, monitoring of customer SLAs.
* Set up post\-sales tech support infrastructure. Will include in\-depth trouble\-shooting on 75F hardware \& software platforms, Root Cause Analysis reporting, reference library \& training tools, remote installations etc.

* Build service sales team for selling value\-added services to existing client base.

* To be involved and carry out planning, execution and updates for all daily on\-site work
* Work with project engineers to submit proposal and implement technology solution to improve HVAC efficiency.
* Maintain and improve the CSAT score


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications include:
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech


 Work Experience
   

  

* Should have 3\-5 years relevant work experience.
* Should have worked with the HVAC industries for majority of his/her career.
* Should have channel as well as Enterprise experience.
* Should have a proven track record of delivering targets consistently.
* Should be familiar with industry\-standard CRM/equivalent

title: Lead Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
   

  

 Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous\-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

 Yes

title: Global Banking & Markets- Lending Operations -Loan Documentation- Associate-Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**OPERATIONS**
 Operations is a dynamic, multi\-faceted division that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.
   

  

 Operations span all product lines and markets, serving as internal business partners who develop the processes and controls, and help to specify the systems that deliver accuracy, timeliness, and integrity to our business.
   

  

**YOUR IMPACT**
 Loan Operations is responsible for ensuring efficient and accurate transaction processing across a broad range of products. Generally, the products supported are complex instruments that require close alignment with the business. A key focus for the organization is establishing strong risk management procedures and controls to ensure the firm and our clients are properly protected.
   

  

 The functional processes managed by the Servicing Team are primarily aligned to the loan life cycle: from Origination; Initial Commitment to the loan; Trade Settlement; Drawdown/funding; Scheduled/Unscheduled Pay\-downs; reconciliation of cash/position breaks; as well as the ongoing management of information related to our portfolio of loans.
   

  

 This role provides a high level of interaction with revenue desks, sales, external agents, as well as exposure to compliance, credit, regulatory teams, treasury, technology, and other Operations areas to ensure we provide excellent client service to our wide client base.
   

  

**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**
 Gain a comprehensive understanding of the bank loan business through servicing a portfolio of syndicated corporate bank debt.
   

  

* Develop your critical thinking competency by investigating and resolving transactional exceptions.
* Coordinate with business, product control and middle office to resolve issues in a timely manner.
* Manage risks related to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and procedures.
* Contribute to automation of functions, de\-risking processes and streamlining of complex processes.
* Enhance your industry knowledge through settlement of complex loan trades.
* Cultivate your problem\-solving skills through managing and reviewing complex legal documentation pertaining to syndicated loans.
* Build your communication skills through daily interactions with the firm’s external business counterparts, such as agent banks, clients, and trading partners.
* Showcase your ability to function as a team player in a highly collaborative environment while working closely with internal stakeholders such as Business Groups, Legal, Tax, Controllers, Technology, Compliance, etc.
* Collaborate with Global teams in New York, Dallas, London, Bengaluru, and Asia on initiatives supporting the loans market.
* Participate in industry initiatives facilitated by the Loan Syndication and Trading Association (LSTA) \& Loan Market Association(LMA)


**Key Responsibilities**
**Loan Documentation Review \& Interpretation**
* Review and interpret complex credit agreements, amendments, and legal documentation to ensure accurate application in operations
* Validate key clauses (e.g., transfer provisions, interest terms, covenants, fee structures) prior to transaction processing


**Controls, Risk \& Compliance**
* Perform pre/post\-transaction checks to ensure compliance with credit agreements and regulatory requirements
* Identify documentation exceptions or inconsistencies and flag/escalate appropriately
* Support reconciliation of cash, positions, and breaks to minimise operational risk


**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a point of contact for Borrowers, Lenders, Agent banks, and internal teams (Front Office, Legal, Credit, Ops)
* Resolve documentation\-related queries and discrepancies efficiently
* Ensure clear and timely communication across stakeholders


**Reporting \& Process Improvement**
* Support preparation of MIS, regulatory reporting, and audit documentation
* Identify opportunities to streamline documentation workflows and enhance controls
* Contribute to automation and standardisation initiatives


**Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 2–6 years of experience in loan operations, loan documentation, or agency servicing
* Exposure to syndicated loans and credit agreements is essential


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of loan documentation, lifecycle events, and servicing processes
* Hands\-on experience with systems such as Loan IQ / ACBS / ClearPar
* Ability to reconcile data and interpret financial transactions accurately


**Core Competencies**
* High attention to detail and risk awareness
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage high volumes under tight timelines
* Effective stakeholder communication and coordination


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Financial or quantitative academic background.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia** 
 — Co\-Founder of Zeta, Radix, and Titan —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




 Neo is seeking a Senior Technical Writer to join our Product Documentation team and take ownership of how Neo's products explain themselves \- through feature docs, user guides, knowledge base articles, FAQs, release notes, and any other technical writing we publish for the outside world.
 



 At Neo, documentation isn't a support function bolted onto the product \- it's a product surface in its own right, and a community asset that accelerates adoption by helping people learn and trust Neo. We run docs\-as\-code and docs\-as\-a\-product: writing lives in Git, ships through review like any other product change, and is held to a real quality bar, built in close partnership with Product and Engineering.
 



 You read specs closely enough to catch what they leave out, understand what a user actually needs to know, and write it clearly. You don't stop at drafting one page at a time, you build the systems behind it: the skill files and prompt templates that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs and tickets, grounded in a tone and style you've codified so every draft, human or AI, sounds like Neo.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system individual contributor role that calls for a combination of strong editorial judgment and an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Write \& organize** 



* Read PRDs and engineering specs closely, and translate them into clear, concise documentation \- user guides, knowledge base articles \- organized with clean, findable information architecture



**Set the standard** 



* Define and maintain Neo's documentation style guide, voice, and tone; and hold every contributor to it
* Own end\-to\-end documentation quality (completeness, accuracy, consistency, tone) across every Neo product, and report on documentation health (coverage, freshness, usage) on an ongoing basis



**Partner \& advocate** 



* Flag issues with the underlying feature, not just the docs, when something won't serve users well or a spec lacks the detail needed for accurate documentation; partner closely with PMs and engineers to close those gaps and stay aligned with the release roadmap



**Build the system** 



* Set direction for Neo's AI\-powered documentation automation \- skill files, prompt templates, scripts \- deciding what to automate and how it should scale; maintain and evolve these systems as products and doc formats change



  





**Skills** 



* Technical fluency to read, question, and explain PRDs and API specifications directly with engineers and PMs, understand and document Neo's APIs and MCP tools, and ensure the accuracy of every customer\-facing doc that depends on them
* Strong written communication \- this is a writing\-first role requiring the editorial judgment to set the bar for others, plus experience defining or maintaining a style guide, voice/tone standard, or review process, and the instinct to know when something's ready to publish
* Strong project\-management instincts \- able to plan, prioritize, and carry a complex documentation project to an accurate, polished finish, with working knowledge of tools like Jira, Linear, or Notion
* Hands\-on experience with AI \- not just prompting in the moment, but building the reusable system behind it (skill files, prompt templates, context files) so AI can produce consistent, on\-brand first drafts without constant re\-prompting
* Systems\-thinking mindset \- with automation instincts, able to design processes that scale as the team and product surface grow



  





**Experience** 



* 5\+ years writing technical documentation, with a solid understanding of version control and experience managing documentation systems
* 1–2\+ years owning editorial standards or leading a documentation function for a team \- ideally at a B2B SaaS or product company
* Track record partnering with product and engineering teams to close documentation gaps and improve PRD quality
* Computer science/ background
* Nice to have: experience contributing to or maintaining an open source project
* Nice to have: a public writing track record on technical or documentation topics \- a blog, newsletter, or bylined guest posts

title: Technical Writer – Hardware Interface Compliance & Certification
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Technical Writer specializing in Hardware Compliance and Certification** 
 to document, structure, and drive the formal certification deliverables for our silicon and platform interfaces. In this role, you will work at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Silicon Validation, and external standards bodies (such as the MIPI Alliance) to produce clear, audit\-ready compliance documentation.
   

  

 You will be responsible for translating complex electrical, timing, and protocol validation data for
 **I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY/D\-PHY, CSI/DSI)** 
 into rigorous Compliance Test Plans, Conformance Statements, Certification Filing Packages, Application Notes, and Hardware Errata.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Certification \& Compliance Documentation:
+ Author, curate, and maintain formal compliance test reports, Implementation Conformance Statements (ICS), and Test Assertion Sheets for I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY, D\-PHY, CSI\-2, DSI\-2\) interfaces.
+ Prepare and package end\-to\-end technical documentation required for formal certification submissions, interoperability workshops (e.g., MIPI Plugfests), and third\-party audit labs.
+ Maintain up\-to\-date compliance matrixes mapping internal validation test results directly to official standards specifications (MIPI Alliance specs, NXP I2C specifications, JEDEC/vendor QSPI norms).

* Engineering Collaboration \& Data Synthesis:
+ Partner closely with Silicon Validation, Signal Integrity (SI), PHY Design, and Embedded Firmware engineers to extract raw test data, oscilloscope captures, and protocol traces.
+ Synthesize raw test outputs into structured, clear documentation (including pass/fail criteria, electrical margins, setup/hold limits, eye\-diagram analyses, and timing diagrams).
+ Document protocol edge cases, hardware errata, and register\-level workarounds for customer integration manuals and Silicon Errata sheets.

* Developer \& Customer Enablement Collateral:
+ Draft technical application notes, hardware integration guidelines, and pinout/routing compliance checklists for customer reference designs.
+ Create precise, high\-quality timing diagrams, state machine charts, and interface connection schematics using tools like Visio, Draw.io, or WaveDrom.

* Process \& Document Lifecycle Management:
+ Own the document review and release lifecycle via Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, ensuring all certification records meet traceability and version\-control requirements.
+ Track active specification changes within standards bodies (e.g., updates to MIPI CSI/DSI specs) and proactively identify required revisions in internal documentation.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3–6\+ years of technical writing experience within the semiconductor, consumer electronics, or embedded hardware industries, with a focus on hardware compliance, silicon validation, or interface specifications.


**Domain \& Technical Knowledge**
* Interface Literacy: Strong conceptual and functional understanding of serial and high\-speed I/O interfaces:
+ I2C \& SPI/QSPI: Bus topology, clock stretching, rise/fall times, multi\-IO modes (Single/Dual/Quad/Octal SPI), timing constraints.
+ MIPI Standards: Familiarity with PHY architectures (D\-PHY, C\-PHY) and upper\-layer protocols (CSI\-2, DSI\-2\), including High\-Speed (HS) vs. Low\-Power (LP) transitions and lane configuration guidelines.

* Interpretation of Hardware Data: Ability to read and accurately interpret:
+ Scope captures (eye diagrams, jitter metrics, rise/fall profiles).
+ Timing diagrams, bus state machines, and register bitfield maps.
+ Official industry conformance documents and test suites.

* Tooling Mastery:
+ Standard authoring platforms: Markdown, AsciiDoc, DITA/XML, MadCap Flare, FrameMaker, or Confluence.
+ Version control systems: Git, Perforce, or SVN.
+ Timing/diagramming tools: WaveDrom, timing diagram editors, Visio, or Illustrator.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience writing formal certification filings or conformance test plans for standards consortiums (MIPI Alliance, USB\-IF, PCI\-SIG, or VESA).
* Basic understanding of automated test logs (e.g., Python test runner logs, SCPI/VISA test report outputs).


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.
