title: Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer - Digital DesignWare IP
description:
**Job Title**
* Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer \- Digital DesignWare IP


**We Are**
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

**You Are**
 You have spent years in the automotive safety world and you know that a well\-written safety case is not just paperwork, it is the difference between a chip that ships and one that sits in legal review for six months. You understand ISO 26262 not as a checklist but as a framework for making defensible engineering decisions under uncertainty.
   

  

 You are comfortable translating a vague customer requirement into a Technical Safety Concept that actually works, and you can explain to a hardware team why their design choice affects ASIL classification without making it feel like a lecture. You do not wait for complete specs to start safety planning. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and build a safety argument that holds up under scrutiny. At Synopsys, you will work on automotive IP that powers the next generation of vehicles, and the safety work you do will matter.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain ISO 26262 work products including Technical Safety Concept, FMEDA, FTA, DFMEA, DFA, Safety Plan, and Safety Case for Digital DesignWare IP
* Collaborate with IP development teams and automotive customers to align functional safety deliverables with project timelines and ASIL requirements
* Evaluate customer quality, functional safety, and reliability requirements, translating them into actionable engineering guidance
* Design and implement automation scripts to streamline safety analysis workflows, including FMEDA and fault injection reporting
* Lead quality and functional safety reviews, generating detailed reports with findings and recommendations for design improvements


**The Impact You Will Have**
* Ensure Synopsys Automotive IP meets ISO 26262 compliance and achieves ASIL B, C, and D certification for safety\-critical automotive applications
* Accelerate customer time to market by delivering complete, audit\-ready safety documentation that reduces integration risk
* Drive measurable improvements in safety process efficiency through automation, reducing manual analysis time across IP families
* Support development of differentiated automotive IP solutions that meet stringent safety demands of ADAS, autonomous driving, and electrification platforms
* Elevate Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner in automotive safety, strengthening customer confidence and market share


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 5\+ years
* Formal training and hands\-on expertise in ISO 26262 functional safety standards, including direct experience developing safety work products for ASIL B, C, or D applications
* Demonstrated experience with semiconductor development flows and digital design at the IP or SoC level
* Proficiency in English for technical writing and cross\-functional collaboration with global teams
* Proven track record qualifying embedded hardware or hardware/software systems to ISO 26262 ASIL levels, including ASIL D
* Experience with ISO 26262 Part 5, hardware description languages like Verilog or VHDL, AEC Q100, or scripting languages such as Python is a plus


**Who You Are**
* You can take a 200\-page customer safety requirement document and pull out the three things that actually affect your IP architecture, then explain them to a design lead in a 10\-minute conversation
* Organized and detail\-oriented, you manage multiple safety deliverables across product lines without losing track of dependencies or deadlines
* You push back constructively when a safety plan is missing critical information or a design decision creates an unmitigated safety risk
* Comfortable working across time zones, you build trust with customers and colleagues through clear communication and follow\-through


**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
 You will join a high\-performing, globally distributed IP team that is at the forefront of automotive safety and reliability innovation. The team collaborates closely with product development, quality assurance, and customer engineering groups to deliver world\-class automotive IP solutions. Together, you will champion functional safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and support customers in deploying safe, reliable automotive products.
   

  

**Rewards And Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons, is a significant player in aerospace and defence solutions in India. Tata Advanced Systems offers a comprehensive range of integrated solutions across Aerostructures \& Aeroengines, Airborne Platforms \& Systems, Defence \& Security, and Land Mobility.
 



 With the requisite capabilities, resources and scale, Tata Advanced Systems is equipped to deliver end\-to\-end solutions across the aerospace and defence value chain—from design, engineering and manufacturing to full platform assembly, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and lifecycle support. Its portfolio spans satellites, missiles, radars, unmanned aerial systems, artillery systems, command and control systems, optronics, homeland security and protected mobility solutions, as well as aircraft and helicopters.
 



  





  





 TASL is strengthening its
 **aircraft Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) capabilities** 
 to support complex defence aviation platforms. Our MRO operations bring together
 **aircraft maintenance, engineering, planning, quality, supply chain and technical services** 
 to deliver safe, reliable and efficient maintenance solutions.
 



 As part of our growing
 **C\-130J MRO program in Bengaluru** 
 , we are building a strong team of aviation professionals with experience in military aircraft maintenance, engineering and technical support
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Technical Services Engineer** 
 to join our
 **C\-130J MRO Engineering \& Planning team** 
 .
 



 The role will provide engineering and technical support for
 **continued airworthiness, SB/AD compliance, Engineering Orders, aircraft configuration control and reliability** 
 , while working closely with Maintenance Planning, Production, Quality, Supply Chain and OEM/regulatory stakeholders.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Review
 **Service Bulletins (SBs), Airworthiness Directives (ADs)** 
 and OEM technical communications for applicability and compliance.
* Draft and issue
 **Engineering Orders (EOs)** 
 with appropriate technical justification and work instructions.
* Track SB/AD compliance and support timely implementation of modifications.
* Maintain
 **aircraft configuration and modification status** 
 within ERP/configuration management systems.
* Provide technical inputs for
 **reliability analysis, recurring defects and component performance** 
 .
* Provide engineering support to Production and Planning during maintenance execution, including technical, tooling and material clarifications.
* Maintain accurate digital engineering records and ensure complete
 **traceability for audits and regulatory compliance** 
 .
* Coordinate with OEMs and internal stakeholders on technical and reliability matters.



 Candidate Profile
 



**Education:** 
 B.E./B.Tech in
 **Aeronautical, Mechanical or Avionics Engineering** 




**Experience:** 
 5\+ years in
 **defence aircraft MRO or OEM technical support** 




 Candidates should have hands\-on exposure to
 **SB/AD evaluation, Engineering Orders, configuration management, reliability and aircraft technical documentation** 
 .
 



 Experience with
 **C\-130J documentation, OEM portals, military aircraft maintenance practices and ERP/configuration management systems** 
 will be preferred.

title: Senior , Tax Services -Global Trade Service + ABAP - Hyderabad, Gurugram ,Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore
description:
**Summary**

 Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business\-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever\-changing global environment with fast\-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
   

  

 We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi\-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought\-after career option.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.

* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration.

 The Team:

 Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune

* Team player with strong communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication in English

 Qualifications \- Preferred:
   

  

* Education with SAP focus (S/4 or ECC Sales and Distribution, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Material Master, Transportation Management)
* Software aptitude in PowerPoint, MS Project, Access, Excel, and/or Visio
* Experience presenting to clients or other decision makers

* Demonstrated interest in international trade or international business
* Strong research, writing, verbal communication, and project management skills
* Ability to bring out\-of\-the\-box solution design aligned to leading practices and differentiated business outcome

title: Senior Specialist – Functional Safety
description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry\-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
   

  

**Group Summary**
 Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world\-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Job title:**
 Senior Specialist – Functional Safety
   

  

**Job Introduction**
 As a
 **System Safety Engineer** 
 (Senior Specialist), you will be responsible for ensuring compliance with ISO 26262 across the complete system development lifecycle. Your role will involve performing system safety analysis (HARA, FSC, TSC), defining safety concepts, deriving safety requirements, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that safety goals are met. You will also perform FMEDA/FTA/FMEA activities, safety validation, and confirm compliance through reviews, audits, and safety case documentation.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Define and manage system requirements and specifications with a strong focus on ISO 26262 functional safety compliance.
* Perform safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, DFA, and FMEDA for eDrive, Transfer case and all\-wheel drive systems.
* Support Functional Safety Management activities, including safety planning, safety case creation, and progress tracking.
* Assist project safety managers in preparing for and conducting functional safety audits and assessments.
* Define and manage system requirements and specifications with a strong focus on ISO 26262 functional safety compliance.
* Perform safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, DFA, and FMEDA for eDrive, Transfer case and all\-wheel drive systems.
* Support Functional Safety Management activities, including safety planning, safety case creation, and progress tracking.
* Assist project safety managers in preparing for and conducting functional safety audits and assessments.


**Knowledge And Education**
* A bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in electrical/electronics, or a related technical field is mandatory.


**Work Experience**
* 10–12 years of experience in defining and specifying system safety requirements and concepts for eDrive or comparable products.
* Proven experience in customer requirement elicitation and direct interaction with customers.
* Hands\-on experience in safety analysis and functional safety management activities.
* Knowledge of risk assessment in system testing is desirable.
* Background in automotive industry is mandatory.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Proven experience in deriving Functional Safety Concept (FSC), Functional Safety Requirements (FSR), Technical Safety Concept (TSC), and Technical Safety Requirements (TSR).
* Strong understanding of Functional Safety Analysis and its critical role in achieving compliance with ISO 26262\.
* Extensive experience performing HARA using the HAZOP method to derive safety goals.
* In\-depth knowledge of the E\-GAS three\-level monitoring concept.
* Solid expertise in ASIL Decomposition and ASIL Reduction techniques.
* Basic understanding of hardware circuits and schematic is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of eDrive functional safety concepts, including subcomponents such as inverter, electric motor (PMSM/ASM), and clutch unit.
* Basic understanding of system testing, software testing, and unit testing is highly desirable.
* Experience in developing Safety Element out of Context (SEooC) is desirable.
* Comprehensive understanding of eDrive units and electric vehicle architectures.
* Good working knowledge of PMSM and ASM operation.
* Familiarity with ASPICE processes and ISO 26262 standards.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams and customers.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills under pressure.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools such as PTC/DOORs/Codebeamer is preferred.


**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)**
 Maintains safe work practices, complies with Magna H\&S requirements, and participates in training and hazard reporting.
   

  

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
   

  

**AI\-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
   

  

**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision\-making.**
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
   

  

**Worker Type**
 Regular / Permanent
   

  

**Group**
 Magna Powertrain

title: Senior Associate Technology Risk Prompt Engineer
description:
**About Us**
**Standard**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering in our Risk, Group Technology team, you will operate as a hands\-on partner to Senior Managers, Risk Managers, and fellow Associates to deliver decision\-useful monitoring and automation across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes.
   

  

 You’ll combine hands\-on data analysis and evidence collation with governed automation and AI\-assisted drafting to improve timeliness, consistency and quality of insights.
   

  

 You’ll build, test and maintain prompt and retrieval patterns, co\-pilot agents and workflow automations using approved tooling (where authorised), while learning and applying required data governance, access controls, privacy and information security and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, logging, version control and audit\-ready artefacts (prompt versions, test evidence and runbooks) to support reviews, thematic work, and other Line 2 oversight and analysis tasks.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering, you will:
   

  

* Supporting delivery of the insights plan by translating priority insight routines into a practical delivery backlog of automation and agent use\-cases (as agreed with the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights)
* Working with Risk Officers and SMEs to capture repeatable workflows (report refreshes, evidence collation, control attestations,issues tracking) and translating them into clear automation/agent requirements with agreed acceptance criteria
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely,trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk\-in\-change and remediation progress
* Building and maintaining workflow automations (data extraction, transformation, scheduling, approvals and notifications) to improve timeliness, reduce manual effort and increase consistency of risk reporting and insight delivery
* Supporting integration with existing platforms (reporting datasets, SharePoint/Teams and risk tooling) and contributing to userguidance and adoption (how\-to guides, training snippets, support triage and continuous improvement)
* Coordinating with Technology, Cyber, Risk, Data and Internal Audit stakeholders on analytics, automation and agent use\-cases,definitions, thresholds and evidence expectations to improve consistency and reduce duplication
* Continuously improving templates, automations and agent behaviours to increase consistency, timeliness and decisionusefulness;documenting lessons learned and maintaining a clear change log of updates
* Supporting uplift tracking (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by automating evidence collation and improving repeatability of reporting outputs
* Operating as a hands\-on specialist, demonstrating strong documentation and quality discipline so automations and agents are safe, repeatable and supportable


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Experience in automation, engineering delivery, analytics engineering, risk analytics or a similar role, with evidence of delivering workflow solutions used by business teams
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and building AI\-assisted workflows/agents using approved tooling (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem) including evaluation, guardrails and iteration based on user feedback
* Strong data skills: ability to work with structured and semi\-structured data, define data quality checks and build reliable refresh pipelines for recurring reporting (e.g., SQL and data wrangling)
* Experience with workflow automation and integration tooling (e.g., Power Automate), scripting (Python preferred) and/or APIs, plus strong documentation and runbook discipline
* Experience delivering solutions for Technology Risk, Cyber Risk, Operational Risk or governance/reporting teams within Financial Services
* Working understanding of risk and control concepts (e.g., technology/cyber risk, operational risk, issues/incidents, control testing) and the ability to translate policy/standards into practical checks within an agent or workflow
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills: ability to capture pain points, prototype solutions and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes; comfortable taking guidance and escalating risks and blockers early
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124055

**Position Summary**
 Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business\-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever\-changing global environment with fast\-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
   

  

 We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi\-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought\-after career option.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work You'll Do \- Intro: Our team specializes in effective technology\-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day\-to\-day business operations.

* Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather and document detailed business requirements for GTS projects.

* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration.

title: SAP S2P (Jaggaer) Functional Engineer
description:
**About Signify**
 Through bold discovery and cutting\-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
   

  

 At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125\+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
   

  

 Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
   

  

**More About The Role**
**SAP S2P (Jaggaer) Functional Engineer**
**Grade :** 
 H15
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

 Signify is amid the design, build and deployment of a global greenfield S/4HANA solution. To support the deployment and ensure stable operations and continuous optimization, we are establishing a global application maintenance organization.
   

  

 The
 **SAP S2P (Jaggaer) Functional Engineer** 
 is responsible operational support in S/4 HANA deployments and supporting and optimizing Jaggaer solutions and SAP S2P in a post go\-live application maintenance environment. Collaborates within a global team and works closely with business stakeholders, partners and cross\-functional teams to ensure stable, compliant and efficient procurement processes. The role focuses on functional support, issue resolution, system stability and operational effectiveness.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Support Procurement Business Process Owners, key users and project teams in maintaining SAP S2P and Jaggaer solutions aligned to the global template and deploying the global S/4 HANA implementation on a local level.
* Provide functional support across core Source\-to\-Pay processes including Sourcing, Contract Management, Supplier Management, Requisitioning, Purchase Order management, and Invoice Processing.
* Provide end\-to\-end functional support in an AMS environment including incident management, service requests, defect resolution and root cause analysis in line with agreed service levels.
* Conduct impact analysis and testing to support quality delivery of changes and enhancements.
* Support S2P processes with strong integration across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Reporting domains.
* Monitor system performance, operational issues and user feedback to ensure stable and efficient day\-to\-day procurement operations.
* Support critical procurement cycles including supplier on\-boarding, contract renewals, and period\-end accruals, ensuring continuity and timely issue resolution.
* Provide user support, functional guidance and knowledge sharing to enable consistent adoption and operational effectiveness.


**Critical Experiences And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferably in Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in Jaggaer and in SAP MM / S2P implementation and/or support.
* Strong functional understanding of S2P processes including Catalog Management, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Performance Management, and e\-Invoicing.
* Experience working in a global application maintenance support or production support environment including stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Experience in system enhancements, incident resolution, problem management, testing and delivery of supportable business solutions.
* Experience supporting critical procurement operations including high\-volume transaction processing and vendor communication.
* Good understanding of integration points between Jaggaer and SAP S/4HANA, as well as adjacent business domains.
* Good understanding of Agile / Scrum ways of working and service management practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Jaggaer or SAP certification in relevant modules is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, complex and highly integrated business environment.


**Grading Differentiators**
* Good knowledge of SAP S2P and Jaggaer functional processes and incident management practices.
* Operates independently within assigned functional scope and delivers with limited supervision.
* Able to resolve moderately complex functional issues across Jaggaer and in integrated SAP processes.
* Contributes effectively to support, enhancement and continuous improvement initiatives


**Everything we’ll do for you**
 You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
   

  

 Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Technical Account Manager -MendixRapidMiner (MXRM), India
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 This role is
 **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** 
 with responsibilities as single post\-sale technical owner of adoption and scale across the customer's footprint in the four products of the specialized GTM for Software, Data and AI — the ICX trio (Mendix, Graph Studio, AI Cloud) and SLC. The mission is to convert sold software into realized technical value and grow that footprint, account by account, holding only a basic understanding of the wider Siemens portfolio — enough to spot and route adjacent opportunities.
   

  

 Advisor\-first: guide adoption, drive the customer's software, data and AI teams to self\-sufficiency, and own the architectural view of how these products fit their landscape. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor. Ring\-fenced from owning commercial, support and delivery — contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation, never the process.
   

  

 Every TAM is a technical practitioner — hands\-on capable and credible in the products and the customer's architecture, able to prototype and prove things in the tooling. How much a TAM builds themselves, versus pulls Specialists in for the heavy build, varies with their product depth and the account. Every TAM is also well trained in the use of generative AI in day\-to\-day work, applying it to work faster and raise the quality of their output.
   

  

 A gated resource on designated accounts only (strategic designation, expansion potential or technical complexity — not ARR), spanning the industrial and non\-industrial customer base; intensity scales with the stakes of the account. The TAM is the field's channel into the Product organization — the natural bridge to the Field CTO — carrying structured voice\-of\-customer upstream into the roadmap and roadmap context back. Primary technical contact for the account; never the commercial or retention contact.
   

  

* Essential Functions
* Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor.
* Run joint technical account planning with the AE, Partner AE and Partner Manager; align adoption and footprint\-growth priorities.
* Maintain a current view of the customer's software architecture and landscape; advise how the four products integrate, partnering with customer\-side and Siemens architects.
* Translate the sold solution into a technical adoption roadmap aligned to the customer's software, data and AI strategy.
* Responsible for capturing the above in a Customer Adoption Plan, and drive progress, collaboration and alignment based on that.
* Adoption \& Technical Execution
* Run the technical kickoff with the customer's software, data and AI teams; turn the sold solution into an adoption plan and hand\-shake with Expert Services on implementation.
* Drive adoption enablement (workshops, office hours) toward customer self\-sufficiency; run a recurring technical account\-review cadence, tracking adoption health and surfacing risks early.
* Get hands\-on to prototype use\-cases and lightly integrate to unblock rollouts — how much depends on your product depth and the account; pull Specialists in for heavy build.
* Collaborate with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation — align on adoption and surface needs, never own delivery.
* Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
* Surface and shape new technical use\-cases; design for the next workload and scale.
* Spot opportunities across the four products and wider Siemens portfolio; route them to the account team and hand qualified commercial signal to the AE.
* Contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation to bids and RFx (typically expansion on covered accounts); the sales/bid team owns the process.
* Internal Operations \& Orchestration
* Track adoption health and technical pipeline for covered accounts; contribute to account planning and internal reviews.
* Orchestrate across AE / Partner AE / Partner Manager / Specialists / Expert Services; triage when to pull Specialists.
* Use and promote internal tools to capture and reuse materials.
* Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
* Build an internal knowledge network and share adoption best practices.
* Contribute to adoption playbooks, reference architectures and supporting tools.
* Coach and mentor other TAMs and team members.
* Field Signal \& Product Feedback
* As the field's channel into Product, capture structured field signal from live adoption and feed it to the Field CTO; carry roadmap context back to the customer.
* Represent the customer's technical needs and adoption blockers internally; escalate and advocate.
* General \- Uphold Siemens' integrity, culture, values and compliance (health, safety, quality); complete required administration including timely expenses; undertake other reasonable duties as required.
* Outcomes \& Measures \- What a successful TAM delivers, per function area — outcomes, not activity.


 Function area: Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): A current, shared technical account plan and architecture view the account team acts on
   

  

 Function area: Adoption \& Technical Execution
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Sold software reaches productive use; the customer's teams become self\-sufficient
   

  

 Function area: Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): New technical use\-cases surfaced and qualified; expansion is technically de\-risked
   

  

 Function area: Internal Operations \& Orchestration
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Account team, Specialists and Expert Services orchestrated without gaps or duplication
   

  

 Function area: Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Adoption know\-how compounds across the team rather than living in one head
   

  

 Function area: Field Signal \& Product Feedback
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Structured field signal reliably reaches Product; customers see themselves in the roadmap
   

  

**Role Interfaces**
 The TAM is the technical hub of the post\-sale account team. It hands qualified expansion signal, adoption status and technical input to the Account Executive (who owns the commercial deal, negotiation and quota) and takes back commercial strategy and account priorities. It aligns adoption with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation and delivery — never the TAM. It triages and pulls Specialists for deep engineering and heavy build, feeds adoption\-health signal to Renewal Specialists (who own renewals and retention), and partners with Partner AE / Partner Managers on joint planning without managing the partner commercial relationship. It advises customer\-side architects on how the four products integrate into their landscape without owning their architecture decisions, and is the standing bridge to the Field CTO, carrying field signal upstream and roadmap context back. The wider customer\-success apparatus — QBRs, CSAT/NPS, success plans, upsell targets, renewals — sits with the AE, Renewal Specialists (and a CSM where engaged), never the TAM.
   

  

**We welcome applicants who meet the following criteria:**
* Product \& technical depth
* Deep expertise in the adoption and account discipline
* Adoption breadth across all four products
* Hands\-on technical capability — practitioner\-level depth; able to prototype, demo and work in the products (required of every TAM; how much you build yourself varies by product depth and account)

title: Integration Engineer (SDK)
description:
**About Bureau** 




  





 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**About the Role \- Integration Engineer** 




  





 Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges? Join our team as an SDK Integration Engineer and be at the forefront of our clients' success. In this role, you will serve as the technical bridge between our SDK products and our clients, guiding external development teams through seamless Web and Mobile SDK integrations. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including Core Engineering, Product, Sales, and Solutions—to ensure a frictionless customer experience.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 



* **Integration Support:** 
 Lead the resolution of SDK integration queries, acting as the primary technical contact and subject matter expert for customers.
* **Customer Experience:** 
 Elevate Customer satisfaction through proactive onboarding support, architectural guidance, and quick resolution of integration blockers.
* **Code\-Level Troubleshooting:** 
 Diagnose complex implementation issues by debugging client code, analyzing network requests, and reviewing SDK behavior across Web and Mobile platforms.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with SDK Engineering and Product teams to channel feedback, report bugs, and advocate for SDK usability and performance improvements.
* **Technical Consulting:** 
 Partner with pre\-sales and onboarding teams to provide technical demonstrations, feasibility assessments, and best practices for integrating our SDKs into diverse technology stacks.
* **Documentation \& Resources:** 
 Create, maintain, and enhance comprehensive SDK documentation, integration guides, code snippets, and fully functional sample applications (via GitHub) to streamline client onboarding.
* **Integration Tooling \& Automation:** 
 Build and maintain internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows to validate client implementations, scale support operations, and reduce time\-to\-resolution.
* **Proactive Analytics \& Optimization:** 
 Utilize advanced analytics and monitoring tools to proactively detect emerging platform issues, identify systemic integration trends, and optimize our self\-service developer portals.
* **Project Management:** 
 Contribute to strategic technical projects that enhance the overall customer journey and add value to the organization's API/SDK ecosystem.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* **Experience:** 
 2–6 years in SDK Integration, Developer Support, Solutions Engineering, or Mobile/Web Development, preferably in a B2B SaaS.
* **Web \& Mobile Proficiency:** 
 Deep understanding of Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) and Mobile ecosystems (native iOS/Swift/Objective\-C, native Android/Kotlin/Java, or cross\-platform frameworks like React Native/Flutter).
* **Advanced Debugging Skills:** 
 Expertise in using developer tools (Chrome DevTools, Xcode, Android Studio), network proxies, and API testing platforms (Postman, cURL) to troubleshoot complex integrations.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to developer audiences as well as non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Scripting \& Automation:** 
 Strong programming foundation with the ability to use languages like Python, Node.js, or Shell to build automation workflows, integration scripts, and sample applications.
* **Infrastructure \& Monitoring:** 
 Experience working with REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Grafana, New Relic, Datadog, AWS).
* **Developer Focus:** 
 A developer\-first mindset paired with strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for creating world\-class technical documentation.
* **Tools:** 
 Hands\-on experience with issue tracking, version control, and support tools (e.g., Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Zendesk, FreshDesk).
* **Flexibility \& Empathy:** 
 Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, working flexible hours when necessary, and handling technical escalations with a mix of empathy and confidence.



  





 If you’re ready to make a significant impact and grow in a challenging yet rewarding environment, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**Our Culture** 




  




* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 




  




* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

title: Associate - Medical Writing
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Scientific data and information are core assets of Lilly. Providing balanced, objective, and accurate information to regulators, the scientific community, health care professionals, payers, and patients in a consistent and timely fashion across the entire drug development lifecycle is fundamental to Lilly.
   

  

 The purpose of the Associate, GSC Regulatory role is to work with cross\-functional, multidisciplinary teams to lead the development of documents intended for regulatory audiences (including, but not limited to, protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, regulatory responses, Investigational New Drug Applications, and marketing authorization applications).
   

  

 Primary Responsibilities: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervision regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.
   

  

* Content Strategy and Execution: Document Preparation, Development and Finalization/Document Management
* Effectively collect and evaluate data, information, and input from multiple sources, functions, and regions to create a cohesive content strategy for writing projects.
* Plan (including organizing/preparing outlines), write (including first\-draft authoring), edit, review, coordinate, and complete the regulatory documents supporting clinical development/product registration.
* Conduct effective document initiation meeting to ensure authoring team alignment and understanding.
* Build scientific\-based rationale that support the purpose of more complex and/or strategic documents.
* Ensure data are presented in a clear, complete, accurate, and concise manner.
* Ensure that key data, statements and conclusions are consistent across related documents, and that statements and conclusions are integrated, accurate, balanced and supported by appropriate data.
* Coordinate expert/scientific reviews, collate reviewer’s comments, adjust content of document as required based on internal/external input, and prepare final version.
* Ensure and coordinate quality checks for accuracy.
* Exhibit flexibility in moving across development and preparation of multiple document types.
* Influence or negotiate change of timelines and content with other team members.
* Work with internal and external experts to develop and prepare presentations.
* As needed, may build and manage relationships with vendors/alliance partners.
* Project and Stakeholder management
* Lead the writing process and apply effective project management skills to ensure timely completion of high\-quality regulatory documents.
* Build/communicate credible writing project timelines.
* Anticipate and mitigate risks to delivery.
* Work with teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely development of documents and escalate issues, as appropriate, to ensure document completion.
* Effectively communicate project status to stakeholders.
* Knowledge and Skills Development
* Maintain and enhance therapeutic area knowledge including disease state and compound(s) for assigned project(s).
* Exhibit flexibility in moving across document types, therapeutic areas, and compounds, depending on project assignment.
* Maintain and enhance knowledge of regulatory guidelines and publication guidelines.
* Possess overarching view of compound, therapeutic area, and external environment (including competitors) with ability to participate effectively in clinical planning, submission strategy planning, customer regulatory responses, and/or current awareness literature updates and reviews.
* Maintain and enhance the scientific communications skills to align with the audience needs and with the changes in technology and platforms.
* Knowledge Sharing
* Provide coaching to others by sharing technical information, giving guidance, answering questions.
* Recognized for technical expertise in specific document development.
* Network with others (including other functions and regions) to identify and share best practices.
* Contribute to process improvements, suggesting opportunities where appropriate.
* Provide database and other tool (e.g., document management systems) expertise.


**Minimum Qualification Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health, communications, technology health related field.
* Demonstrated experience in technical/ regulatory scientific writing.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Successful completion of writing exercise (a writing exercise is required as part of the candidate evaluation process)


**Other Information/Additional Preferences**
* Graduate degree with formal research component or in life sciences.
* Demonstrated mastery of verbal and written English skills in the medical, scientific or technical writing fields.
* Clinical pharmacology, therapeutic area, or other medical and scientific specific knowledge and experience specific to hiring area (e.g., neuroscience, oncology, cardiovascular, immunology or endocrine expertise).
* Experience writing regulatory, clinical trial documents and/or publications
* Experience in clinical development, clinical trial process or regulatory activities.
* Demonstrated project management and time management skills.
* Demonstrated high\-level end\-user computer skills (e.g., word processing, tables and graphics, spreadsheets, presentation and templates).

title: Content Manager – GHR Service Center
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
 We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Content Manager to join our GHR Service Center team. This role will be responsible for managing and optimizing employee\-facing and support\-facing content, ensuring it aligns with GHR objectives, content standards and governance policies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a strong background in content administration, creative writing, platform management, and stakeholder collaboration. You will play a key role in building and supporting content expansion in HR, managing BAU (Business as Usual) activities, and leveraging/managing AI tools/applications to enhance content delivery and employee experience.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 The team you will be joining plays a key role in the overall success of the Talent organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. In your role you will strive for cutting\-edge solutions, which are straightforward and scalable. You will help the Talent Org build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

**Content Administration \& Governance**
* Develop and maintain content standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks to ensure consistency and compliance across all HR content.
* Manage the document lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, publishing, archiving and retirement of content.
* Ensuring all content meets State Street’s legal, regulatory, organizational standards, particularly in a highly regulated financial services environment.


**Professional Writing \& Content Development**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate complex HR policies, benefits and processes into clear, engaging and user\-friendly content for global audience.

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, Human resources or related fields.
* 7\+ years of experience in content management, preferably within HR or employee or customer facing environment.
* 5\+ years in HR content management and content writing
* Strong writing, editing, and proof\-reading skills, with the ability create clear and engaging content for global audience
* Experience managing content platforms, including knowledge bases, HR portals and chatbot.
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application in content management
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working in global or multi\-regional organization.
* Knowledge of content governance, document management lifecycle, and content standards
* Proficiency in content management systems (CMS), Microsoft office Suite, and collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint, Trello, etc.)
* Outstanding written English Skills
* Excellent communication, organization and time management skills
* Strong skills in creating original content that targets a specific audience and meets company objective
* Strong attention to detail and consistency
* Prepared to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Comfortable working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds


**What We Value**
* Experience working in a global environment
* Familiarity with HR policies, processes and requirements
* Verifiable experience with MS office 365, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite

 Our mission is to make employability measurable, personalized, and actionable, helping students understand where they stand and what they need to do to become job\-ready.

 This role involves researching topics, understanding learner needs, structuring course content, and writing clear, engaging, and practical learning material. title: Lead II - Creative Design
description:
**Role Description**
 The Sr. Communications Lead develops and drives the communications strategy for IT \& Engineering (ITES), ensuring leaders, colleagues, and key stakeholders receive clear, consistent, timely, and business\-relevant communications. The role shapes how ITES priorities, decisions, accomplishments, and strategic initiatives are communicated across a global organization. This is a senior communications role with both strategic and hands\-on accountability. 6\-10 years The Sr. Communications Lead sets communications standards and messaging frameworks, serves as a trusted advisor to leadership, and directly leads high\-visibility communications where senior ownership is required. The role works closely with ITES leadership, Corporate Communications, Human Resources, and business and functional partners to align messaging, sequencing, audiences, and channels. Key Responsibilities Communications Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Own and continuously evolve the ITES communications strategy in alignment with ITES priorities and enterprise communications standards.
* Develop integrated annual and quarterly communications plans that connect leadership priorities, major initiatives, organizational updates, and key milestones.
* Define audience, message, channel, timing, and cadence for communications so stakeholders receive the right level of information at the right time.
* Translate complex technology, business, and organizational topics into clear narratives that explain what matters, why it matters, and what stakeholders need to know or do.
* Anticipate communications needs and advise leaders on sequencing, stakeholder impact, message risk, and the most effective communications approach. Executive \& Leadership Communications
* Serve as a senior communications advisor to ITES leaders, providing counsel on messaging for high\-visibility, sensitive, or complex topics.
* Develop executive communications including key messages, leadership updates, talking points, presentations, announcements, Q\&A materials, town hall content, and follow\-through summaries.
* Ensure leadership messages are consistent across functions and geographies while allowing appropriate tailoring for different audiences.
* Support leaders in communicating strategic priorities, decisions, organizational updates, business outcomes, and expectations with clarity and credibility.
* Prepare leaders for major communications moments by identifying likely stakeholder questions, areas of concern, and required follow\-up. Strategic \& Enterprise Communications
* Lead communications for major ITES priorities and strategic initiatives, including digital, data, AI, innovation, operational excellence, and capability\-building efforts.
* Develop communications that make technical initiatives relevant to the business by connecting them to customer, colleague, operational, financial, or strategic outcomes.
* Coordinate communications across global IT teams and Centers of Excellence to maintain a coherent ITES narrative and reduce conflicting or duplicate messaging.
* Develop communications that recognize accomplishments, reinforce strategic focus areas, and improve visibility of ITES contributions and business value. Channels, Content \& Communications Governance
* Define and maintain communications standards, templates, editorial guidance, and reusable tools that improve quality and consistency across ITES.
* Manage the integrated communications calendar and coordinate content across channels including email, Teams, intranet, newsletters, town halls, leadership forums, presentations, and other internal channels.
* Establish appropriate review and approval processes for high\-impact communications while keeping routine communications efficient and timely.
* Partner with Corporate Communications to align ITES content with enterprise brand, editorial standards, and enterprise\-wide channels where applicable.
* Maintain message discipline and content accuracy, challenging unclear, inconsistent, unsupported, or unnecessarily complex communications before release. Stakeholder Partnership \& Communications Enablement
* Build strong working relationships with ITES leadership, Corporate Communications, Human Resources, business partners, functional teams, and subject\-matter experts.
* Coach leaders and content owners on audience\-focused writing, message clarity, presentation structure, and effective use of communications channels.
* Create practical guidance and self\-service resources that allow teams to communicate routine updates consistently without creating unnecessary central dependency.
* Coordinate message timing across stakeholders so major communications are sequenced appropriately and do not compete with or contradict one another. Measurement \& Continuous Improvement
* Define practical measures for communications effectiveness, including reach, engagement, understanding, timeliness, and stakeholder feedback.
* Use channel data, stakeholder feedback, and recurring themes to identify communication gaps and improve messaging, formats, cadence, and channel selection.
* Periodically review the effectiveness of the ITES communications approach and recommend changes based on business needs, leadership priorities, and audience behavior. Experience \& Capabilities
* Demonstrated experience developing and leading communications strategy in a complex, global, matrixed organization.
* Exceptional executive writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information without losing accuracy or intent.
* Strong executive presence and judgment, including the ability to advise senior leaders and handle sensitive information appropriately.
* Experience developing multi\-channel internal communications and coordinating communications across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align multiple contributors around a clear narrative and communications plan.
* Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution, from shaping the communications approach to personally developing high\-priority content.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology and organizational priorities to business\-relevant outcomes.
* Experience working in a regulated, life sciences, healthcare, technology, or similarly complex environment is preferred. Success Measures
* ITES priorities, decisions, and strategic initiatives are communicated clearly, consistently, and at the appropriate time.
* Leadership communications are concise, aligned, audience\-appropriate, and ready for use with minimal rework.
* Stakeholders demonstrate improved understanding of key ITES priorities, initiatives, and business outcomes.
* Communications channels are used intentionally, with measurable reach and engagement and reduced duplication of messages.
* High\-impact communications are anticipated and planned rather than developed reactively.
* Leadership and stakeholder feedback indicates that ITES communications are credible, useful, and business\-relevant.


**Skills**
 SharePoint, Instructional Design, Executive Writing, Presentation Development

description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
 



 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
 



 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Tackle founder\-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data\-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook
* Shadow → Own. Start by shadowing founders and executives across GTM, Product, and Operations, and quickly take ownership of initiatives with significant revenue, customer, or cost impact
* Be the connective tissue. Translate hard manufacturing realities from shop\-floor SMEs into crisp product requirements; then turn those into value propositions sales can run with
* Scale what works. Systematize every win—dashboards, SOPs, automations—so the next team member can sprint from day 1
* Rinse, learn, repeat. Each quarter you'll rotate (sales → CS → product → biz ops), compounding domain depth while keeping a 10,000\-foot strategic view



  





**You Might Thrive Here If You** 



* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first\-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic \& data
* Play in spreadsheets \& slides with equal joy. Google Sheets in the morning; crisp narrative memo by lunch; client demo at 4 PM
* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0\.1 today and iterate than debate v2\.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts \& budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1\-5 years of high\-intensity experience. Early\-stage start\-up, tier\-one consulting, I\-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out\-execute peers



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Must\-Haves** 



* 1\-4 years of experience in start\-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves** 



* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.



  





**Benefits** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development

description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent

**Job Description**
**Title** 
 Change Specialist
   

  

**Department** 
 Enterprise Service Management
   

  

**Location**

**Reports To** 
 SENIOR MANAGER \- CHANGE MANAGEMENT
   

  

**Level** 
 4
   

  

 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Service Operations team, part of the Enterprise Service Management function and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 The Change Management function owns the centralized Change Management process for Technology and ensures a standardized implementation across all systems for efficient and prompt Change request handling to minimize risks to the Production environment. The team also administers change control over non\-production environments. The team works in close coordination with other Technology and Business teams globally.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 The Change Management Specialist within the Technology Change Management team plays a key role in ensuring that technology\-driven changes are successfully adopted across the organisation. Working closely with project teams, technology leaders, service management, and business stakeholders, the role focuses on supporting both the day to day activities around Change Management as well as developing and executing change management strategies, and driving user adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working. The specialist is responsible for stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications planning, training coordination, and measuring adoption outcomes to ensure changes deliver their intended business benefits while minimising disruption to operations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring strong experience in Technology change management and a proven track record of supporting complex technology transformations. They will act as a trusted advisor to project and delivery teams, helping to identify adoption risks, build stakeholder readiness, and foster a positive change culture. Strong ServiceNow knowledge and hands\-on experience are essential, particularly in supporting Technology Change Management processes, reporting, workflow optimisation, and governance activities. The ideal candidate will be comfortable leveraging ServiceNow data and capabilities to improve visibility, compliance, and operational effectiveness, while working collaboratively across technology and business teams. Excellent communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and analytical skills are critical, along with a passion for helping people and organisations successfully navigate change.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Independently managing complex and high\-risk changes throughout their lifecycle.
* Chairing and facilitating CAB meetings, ensuring appropriate risk assessment, impact evaluation, approval routing, and stakeholder engagement.
* Driving continuous improvement initiatives, including workflow optimization, automation opportunities, AI adoption, and Change Management transformation activities.
* Monitoring KPIs, operational metrics, compliance controls, and service trends, proactively identifying risks and recommending corrective actions.
* Engaging with various other practices within Service Management such as Incident and Problem Management, SACM, Service Reporting, Service Control.


**About You**
 You have extensive experience in IT Change Management and a strong understanding of ITIL practices, governance frameworks.
   

  

 You are comfortable operating independently, making sound risk\-based decisions, and managing competing priorities across a global organization.
   

  

 You will ideally demonstrate:
   

  

* Strong experience in Change Management within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven ability to independently manage high\-risk and business\-critical changes.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise with a deep understanding of Change product, platform capabilities, reportings and automation, with a proven ability to drive process optimization, champion OOTB solutions and support strategic transformation initiatives.
* Good facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including leading CAB meetings, post change reviews and Unauthorized changes.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and drive improvements.
* Continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify automation and AI\-enabled opportunities.
* This role works UK business hours to enable close collaboration with teams in UK and Canada.
* Succesfuly engages and influences stakeholders, building effective relationships to drive alignment and achieve diresired outcomes.


**Feel rewarded**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.  At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life\-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
   

  

 As a pioneer and market leader in robotic\-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
   

  

 Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
   

  

 Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long\-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
   

  

 Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
 The Cardiovascular Program Specialist (CVPS) will provide expert clinical support, education, and training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci cardiac surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Cardiovascular Sales Manager (CVSM) to ensure safe and effective product adoption while driving positive patient outcomes. This role will be a part of a future small team of strategic sales professionals across the country who are focused on developing cardiac surgeons, and all those associated with cardiac programs.
   

  

**Clinical Support \& Case Coverage**

* Serve as a clinical expert for product setup, troubleshooting, and optimal use during live cases.
* Ensure compliance with clinical and safety protocols.
* Expand the user base collaborating with CVSM to cultivate a training pipeline of new surgeons.
* Exhibit proficiency in multiple technology platforms to effectively support DaVinci adoption of Multiport Single Port, digital solutions, and customer needs.
* Promote advanced instruments and accessories to enhance surgical performance and promote surgeon autonomy.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal teams to identify and capitalize on opportunities for expanding the use of the da Vinci® Surgical Systems and strengthening Intuitive’s partnership with healthcare facilities.


**Training \& Education**

* Administer individualized surgeon and care team training sessions onsite and assist with organizing appropriate mentoring programs.
* Support new site start\-ups by delivering onboarding programs and in\-services.

* Maintain flexibility to support after\-hours cases and provide weekend support as needed, dictated by the territory's adoption of robotic surgery.

* Provide clinical insights to the commercial team to shape strategy and drive business growth.
* Participate in physician education programs, workshops, and regional/national conferences.
* Facilitate the adoption of our digital solutions through enhancing our customer infrastructure and capabilities.
* Communicate and collaborate with ancillary equipment manufacturers to develop strategies to ensure overall programmatic success

* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.

* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure environments (OR/Cath lab)
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.

title: Productivity & Content Architect
description:
Dyson Global IT
   

  

 At Dyson, we demand the highest standard of performance from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them. We are a community that appreciates and advocates better engineering. A community of pioneers.
   

  

 Dyson IT are mid\-transformation. Our aim, to create robust IT architecture, to manage data effectively and efficiently and continue to grow our world\-class team. A team who is strategic, enabling business acceleration, growth and success.
   

  

 Workplace Platform team
   

  

 The Workplace Platform Team Act As a Key Technology Partner For Microsoft 365 Collaboration Capabilities, Productivity Platforms, Governance, Adoption And Secure Digital Solutions Across The Organisation
   

  

* Lead and support Microsoft 365 collaboration, productivity, automation and employee experience use cases.
* Partner with IT product owners and platform teams to ensure standards are followed across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot, security, compliance and collaboration platforms.
* Support innovation, adoption and governance across Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Copilot capabilities.

 The Role
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of IT \- Workplace, you will provide hands\-on architecture leadership for employee productivity and knowledge experience across Microsoft 365 and workplace services. The role will shape the design, governance, integration, adoption and support model for core productivity capabilities including Microsoft 365 Apps, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Viva, enterprise search, content lifecycle management and archiving, alongside Azure Virtual Desktop where it supports modern workplace access and productivity scenarios.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a senior technical specialist who can work with business stakeholders, architects, engineers and service teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable and supportable Microsoft 365 solutions. The role requires strong depth across Microsoft 365 Apps, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Viva, Teams, Exchange Online, enterprise search and knowledge discovery, content lifecycle and archiving, Power Platform, Copilot/Copilot Studio, Purview, Defender and Entra ID, with a practical understanding of AVD integration and operational considerations.

* Experience designing Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Dataverse, including environment strategy and DLP governance.
* Good understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, knowledge grounding, permissions implications and AI governance considerations.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Purview, information protection, sensitivity labels, retention, audit, eDiscovery, data loss prevention controls, records management and compliant content archiving.

* Ability to design secure, scalable and supportable solutions, documenting HLD/LLD, operational runbooks and decision records.
* Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams, external vendors, security, architecture, product and application delivery teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications / Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or equivalent Power Platform solution design experience.

 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique.
